title: Tri-State Process Identity & Recycling Oracle
problem: Process killing relies on PID alone; recycled PIDs on Windows risk terminating innocent OS/IDE processes.
evidence: Verified in WS2 (EXP-WS2-COMP-001) and WS10 (EXP-WS10-MUT-001, MUT-02).
proposed_change_boundary: Require start-time metadata comparison before any process termination; fail closed on UNKNOWN.
migration_impact: Legacy leases lacking start time treated as UNKNOWN (kill forbidden).
rollback: Revert to PID liveness check with manual operator confirmation.
known_risks: Processes with inaccessible metadata cannot be automatically cleaned up; requires operator alert.
stop_condition: Termination of any process whose start time mismatches lease record.
